text.p: Heavy appliance manufacturer Email Ltd said on Monday that it had acquired Impact Steel, a sheet, coil and stainless steel distributor with operations in Melbourne, Adelaide, Brisbane and Sydney.

Email manager director John Hanna would not reveal the purchase price, but told Reuters Impact Steel had an annual turnover of A$50-60 million and would be "earnings per share positive from the beginning".
In a statement, Hanna said the acqusition further strengthened Email's Metals Group, bridging additional processing and distribution capabilities.
"Metals has performed well in recent years, achieving substantial profit growth," Hanna said.

Impact Steel's largest branch is in Melbourne where it operates worldclass processing equipment, the Adelaide brand sells sheet and coil products, while Brisbane and Sydney offices sell stainless steel only, the statement said.
Alan Freer, Email's group general manager, metals, said the purchase was a major step for Email Metals Group, and would assist with growth strategies in flat products.
